answer_1.quote: KAT is a generation-based reader that learns to generate the answer given the retrieved knowledge.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answer texts for visual questions

answer_2.quote: We adopt MRR and Precision at a cut-off of 5 as our automatic evaluation metric... We follow the standard evaluation metric recommended by the VQA challenge.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a human evaluation on AMT of the retrieved entities and sentences to demonstrate that the knowledge retrieved by EnFoRe better supports the correct answers... workers are asked to judge which system's set of highlighted entities and sentences best supports the given answer.
answer_4.guideline: Workers judged which system's retrieved entities and sentences best support the given answer.
